english.title: Use a vehicle carrying a racing boat - rear projection not clearly visible

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ROAD VEHICLES CONSTRUCTION AND USE REGULATIONS 1986

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), carrying a racing boat propelled solely by oars which had a rearward projection exceeding one metre when the load had not been rendered clearly visible to other persons using the road within a reasonable distance from its rear and side.
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 82(7) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
used on a road of a vehicle
carrying a racing boat propelled solely by oars
having a rearward projection exceeding one metre
the projection not clearly visible to other road users
within a reasonable distance from the front and side

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 82(7) does not apply to straddle carriers.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) See also offence wordings: H3336 and H3337.
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant used **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) which was carrying a racing boat having a rearward projection of **(..SPECIFY PROJECTION..) metres which was not clearly visible to other road users.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
